title: Skulldash
description: Skulldash is a fast-paced arcade megawad where players must collect Skulltokens within a strict time limit to unlock each level's exit. Featuring a tier-based level hub, the campaign spans environments like tech bases, Aztec temples, icy caverns, and space. Players battle standard and custom monsters, search for secret blue Skulltokens for bonus time, and take on distinct bosses.
